productDecisionsOpen.title: Portuguese regional variant (pt vs pt-PT vs pt-BR)
productDecisionsOpen.currentBehavior: UI locale code is `pt` only. Quasar maps pt→pt-BR. Machine drafts use international Portuguese (você) with PT/BR lexical mix (e.g. Utilizador vs senha/Salvar).

alternatives.label: pt-BR — Brazilian Portuguese
cons: Would require lexical cleanup of PT-PT forms

impact.preferred_locale: Stay `pt` or migrate to `pt-BR` (requires APP_LANGUAGES + DB migration)
impact.uiOptions: Would change 59-language list if introducing pt-BR

alternatives.label: pt-PT — European Portuguese
cons: Quasar has no first-class pt-PT pack (would use pt or custom)
Conflicts with current Quasar pt-BR mapping

impact.quasar: Need alternate pack or accept pt-BR chrome mismatch

alternatives.label: pt — single code with documented working norm
cons: Lexical mix remains until human regional pass

impact.translations: Human review enforces chosen norm under `pt`

productDecisionsOpen.recommendation: Prefer VARIANT C short-term (stabilize under `pt`, human regional pass). Defer introducing pt-PT/pt-BR locale codes until product explicitly wants split markets.
productDecisionsOpen.risk: Shipping mixed PT/BR copy without decision confuses users and reviewers.

productDecisionsOpen.title: Donor / Donee product role labels
productDecisionsOpen.currentBehavior: English role terms kept in MACHINE_DRAFT catalogs (aligned DE/FR/ES/PL/IT/PT/CS/HU/NL/RO).
productDecisionsOpen.recommendation: Keep English until global UX terminology workshop; do not localize piecemeal.
productDecisionsOpen.risk: Inconsistent role names across languages damage product clarity.

productDecisionsOpen.title: Contribution vs Donation vs Token top-up wording
productDecisionsOpen.currentBehavior: Help act ≈ Contribution/Wsparcie/Contributo/Příspěvek pomoci/Hozzájárulás/Bijdrage/Contribuție; wallet recharge ≈ Recarga/Ricarica/Auffüllung/Dobití/Feltöltés/Steun/Sprijin — charity 'donation' avoided where context is tokens.
alternatives: Keep Donation only for charity contexts
productDecisionsOpen.recommendation: Human linguistic review per language; preserve product meaning (help ≠ charity-only).
productDecisionsOpen.risk: Users may think dreamhubb is only financial fundraising.

productDecisionsOpen.title: Post terminology (Publication / Wpis / Beitrag / …)
productDecisionsOpen.currentBehavior: FE uses localized content-unit terms (Publication, Wpis, Beitrag, Publicación, Pubblicazione, Publicação, Příspěvek, Bejegyzés, Bericht, Postare).
productDecisionsOpen.recommendation: Keep localized forms; confirm in human review.
productDecisionsOpen.risk: Low if consistent within each locale.

productDecisionsOpen.title: Feed label (loanword vs localized)
productDecisionsOpen.currentBehavior: Often kept as Feed; FR Fil; CS Nástěnka; HU Hírfolyam; NL Tijdlijn; RO Flux — alternatives in glossaries.
alternatives: Localize (Fil, Tablica, Bacheca, Nástěnka, Hírfolyam, Tijdlijn, Flux, …)

productDecisionsOpen.title: Token product term
productDecisionsOpen.currentBehavior: Token kept as product term (not ficha/jeton/moneda).
productDecisionsOpen.recommendation: Keep Token unless product rebrands economy.

openQaFindings.note: PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED Donor/Donee — kept as English loanwords ('Donor', 'Donee'). 'Donor' is an accepted Romanian word; 'donee' is not and is declined ad hoc ('un donee', 'doneii', 'Donorului'). Alternatives: Dăruitor / Ajutător / Beneficiar / Solicitant.

Donation vocabulary is mixed: edit.donations='Sprijin', tokensToTopUp='TOKENURI PENTRU SPRIJIN', topUpThePost='SUSȚINE POSTAREA', notifications 'a susținut', success 'Tokenuri donate cu succes', glossary lists 'Sprijin / Încărcare'. Human to finalise (Sprijin/Susținere vs Donație).
'Feed' kept as loanword with Romanian definite article ('feedul'); alternative 'Flux' (LINGUISTIC_REVIEW_REQUIRED).

Number-carrying strings without plural choice (success.donationSuccessful, notifications.topUpTitle) use number-agnostic 'Tokenuri …: {amount}' wording to avoid '1 tokenuri' / missing 'de'. Proper fix requires plural-aware call sites (FE code change, out of scope for 4E.5).

legal.englishOnlyNotice: EN source hard-codes 'A Slovak version…' (a source/product bug). pl and fr translations still say 'slovacă/słowacka'; ro now says Romanian. Source should become locale-neutral or per-locale.
Terms naming inconsistency: settingsPages.privacy.terms 'Termeni și condiții' vs termsOfUseLink/legal 'Termenii de utilizare' (mirrors EN 'Terms and Conditions' vs 'Terms of Use').

onboarding.tokens.page1Title 'Titlu despre cum funcționează' and page2Option 'Îi punem în legătură pe visători cu cei' mirror EN placeholder/incomplete-sentence source copy ('Headline of how it works', 'We connect dreamers with those'); product copy needs final text before translation can be judged.

Gender-neutral possessives: 'lui' / 'visul lui' / 'Postările lui' (userBlocked, explainerTitle4, legacySideBlurb) vs 'lor' elsewhere; EN uses 'their'/'his or her'. Consider 'sale' / 'lor' or rephrasing. Not a grammatical error.
Token package names are playful calques (pumn / mână / portofel / sac / cufăr / camion de tokenuri) — humans to confirm tone and size ordering.
common.iosPaymentsUnavailable keeps developer wording ('cap sync/pod install'); earnUi.beTaskTitlesNote mentions API/backend i18n — internal-facing strings, confirm they should be user-visible.
42 identical-to-EN keys (brand, place names, language autonyms, loanwords).

openQaFindings.note: PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED Donor/Donee — untranslated, uninflectable English labels inside Ukrainian sentences (onboarding.sideDonee/sideDonor, onboardingInfo.side.*, profileUi.rateDonor 'Оціни свого Donor', reviewPlaceholder, typeYourMessageForDonee, aboutDonee, plural 'Donor можуть…').

Brand/term 'Token' used as indeclinable Latin loanword in every case ('Мішок, повний Token', 'Придбані Token', 'Твої Token додано', 'їх' as pronoun). Natural alternative: 'токен/токени' (Cyrillic, declinable). Pluralization identical for all forms, so runtime-safe; style/product decision.

Existing language names: 'he' → 'Єврейська' is ambiguous (could mean Yiddish); standard Ukrainian name for Hebrew language is 'Іврит'. 'nl' → 'Голландська' (existing); 'Нідерландська' is the standard name. Not auto-changed (style/consistency with adjective pattern).

{name} placeholders after prepositions that require case (profileUi.aboutUser 'Про {name}', notificationsPage.commentTitle/replyTitle 'від {name}', posts.replyFrom, auth.replyToUser 'Відповідь для {name}…') — fine for usernames/handles, wrong if real first names are shown (UA names inflect: 'від Олени').

onboarding.tokens.page1Title 'Заголовок про те, як це працює', page2Option 'Ми поєднуємо мрійників із тими', page3Title 'Рух коштів' mirror placeholder-like EN copy; product copy to be rewritten for all locales.

common.tokenShop.iosPaymentsUnavailable contains developer-facing text ('Перезбери iOS після cap sync/pod install.') copied from EN; should not be shown to end users. earnUi.beTaskTitlesNote is also developer-facing ('…доки на сервері не буде i18n').

onboardingInfo.goal.problem.description — 'залишатися сам на сам' uses a masculine-leaning idiom with 'сам'; consider neutral 'залишатися наодинці'. Other strings are gender-neutral ('І тепер усе готово!', 'Заблокованих користувачів поки немає.').
'Wi‑Fi' in common.info.openNetworkSettings uses U+2011 (non-breaking hyphen); some fonts lack the glyph — consider ASCII hyphen.
settingsPages.faq.q6 'Перейди до Налаштування → Допомога та підтримка' — menu path in nominative after 'до'; consider «Налаштування» in guillemets like q4/q5.

openQaFindings.note: PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED Donor/Donee — English role labels kept inside Bulgarian text; uninflected and not definite-articled (Bulgarian would normally use 'Donor-ът'/'Donee-то' or a native noun).
Tokens naming: English plural used as singular noun in compounds ('Юмрук Tokens', 'Торба с Tokens') and counted forms ('1 Token'); wording needs product + linguist decision (токени/жетони).

Grammatical gender / style: onboarding.tokens.page4Title 'А сега всичко е готово за старт!' fine; no masculine-speaker assumptions found, but accomplishedDream.description 'Твоята мечта беше сбъдната от' + name relies on runtime name concatenation — verify layout.

onboarding.tokens.page1Text / tokensOnboarding.description are long near-duplicates; page3Title 'Паричен поток' ('Cash flow') mirrors EN placeholder-like copy — product copy to be rewritten for all locales.
common.tokenShop.iosPaymentsUnavailable contains developer-facing text ('Изгради iOS отново след cap sync/pod install.') copied from EN; should not be shown to end users.

Word-for-word EN calques worth a linguist's pass: 'Ами сега. Тук няма нищо...' (system.notFoundTitle), 'Печели' (Earn), 'Профил' vs 'Акаунт' (both used: 'Създай профил' vs 'Настройки на акаунта'), 'Имейл' vs 'електронна поща' (changeEmailAddress).
22 strict identical-to-EN keys (language nativeNames, dreamhubb, Donor/Donee, Tokens) — acceptable.
legal.* namespace is navigation/labels only; full Terms/Privacy bodies remain English-only (englishOnlyNotice present) pending legal review.

openQaFindings.note: PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED Donor/Donee — kept as English loanwords; 'donee' is not a Dutch word and may confuse users. Declension handled as invariable plural 'donors'/'donees' and 'de donee' (onboarding, profile, typeYourMessageForDonee). Alternatives: Gever / Ontvanger / Aanvrager.

Homonymy: 'bericht' = Post (Bericht plaatsen, Berichten laden) but also used for chat/review messages (typeYourMessageForDonee 'Typ je bericht voor een donee...', profileUi.reviewPlaceholder, inspirationNeedTextOrImage 'kort bericht'). Consider 'boodschap'/'tekst' for non-post uses.

Donation metaphor mixed: edit.donations='Steun', tokensToTopUp='TOKENS OM TE STEUNEN', topUpThePost='STEUN HET BERICHT', byTop='via steun', notifications 'gesteund', but glossary lists 'Opladen / Steun'. Consistent in practice (Steun), glossary row should be finalised by human.

'Melding' is used both for notifications (Meldingen) and for abuse reports (Melding verzenden, Melding succesvol verzonden, reportIssue). Context-dependent ambiguity; consider 'Rapportage'/'Rapport' or 'Klacht' for reports.
settings.privacy.terms 'Algemene voorwaarden' vs termsOfUseLink / legal 'Gebruiksvoorwaarden' — terminology consistency (EN source differs: 'Terms and Conditions').
onboarding.tokens.page2Option ('Wij brengen dromers samen met mensen die') is an incomplete sentence mirroring placeholder-like EN copy; page3Title 'Geldstroom' similarly terse.

Register: 'Time-out van het verzoek' (errors.timeout) is a literal calque; consider 'Het verzoek duurde te lang'. 'Vuist vol/Zak vol/Kist vol' token package names are playful calques; 'Vuist vol' could be 'Vuistvol' — humans to confirm tone.
Gender-neutral possessives: 'zijn of haar' (legacySideBlurb, tokens.page1Text) vs 'hun' (userBlocked, 'Hun berichten') and 'zijn droom' (explainerTitle4) — inconsistent gender-inclusive style.
scripts/i18n/nl-4e5-translations-data.mjs was patched to match the 4 fixes (so re-running nl-4e5-fill-and-apply does not regress). Fixes are applied to src/i18n/nl/{auth,common,onboarding}.ts only.

Placeholder-aware strings that carry a number without plural choice (donationSuccessful, topUpTitle) remain number-agnostic workarounds; proper fix = plural-aware call sites (src/pages/DonorPages/PostDetailPage.vue passes a hard-coded English fallback; NotificationComponent.vue uses t() without plural arg) — FE code change out of scope for 4E.5.
